text: ok so uh, do i need to remake my buildings or something to get the stairs to work correctly? the bottom of the staircase i walk right up it now, which is great. i still am having that problem right at the top of the staircase, and i see in this staircase at least that it has the problem i poionted out where the floor is still sitting higher than the last step. and then the inverse, coming down the steps, i have problems getting onto the stairscase still. i can go place now pieces if that would help but i am saying the already placed pieces didnt really change from what it seems
resolution: Resolved 'do I need to remake my buildings' for stairs. Confirmed on the live map 'main' (9 staircases) that the bottom-of-stairs walk was fixed by the step-height crest fix, and the remaining top problems were (a) the floor-thickness gap on stairs not sitting on a floor and (b) the real culprit — invisible stair boundary walls (req_1501). No remake needed: all fixes are read-path/bake so existing stairs are corrected on next Compile. Fixes: step height 0.35->0.5 (ab003a9ca/9eb8bc304), walls rest on floors (24bcfca88), stairs collide as slope only (92690b54c).
